note: Art direction for Flower-Souls (MB1), chosen by the owner on 2026-09-27: the Yao (Dao) ritual painting 'Chia Fin', Guangxi, 1920, Ethnological Museum Berlin (public domain; photo CC0 by Daderot, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chia_Fin_-_Guangxi_province,_China,_1920_-_Ethnological_Museum,_Berlin_-_DSC01315.JPG). The owner's bar (2026-09-27): the cards must look like photos of the real old paintings in a museum, never like cute game or children's art.
style: A photograph of an authentic Yao (Dao) ritual scroll painting from the mountains of northern Vietnam and southern China, about a hundred years old, in exactly the style of the reference image. Hand-ground mineral and plant pigments on thick handmade paper: a vermilion and brick-red ground that is uneven, faded and rubbed through in places, with small stains, creases, flaking paint and visible paper fibres. Figures drawn flat and frontal in the reference's own conventions: stiff, hieratic, symmetrical poses, small stylised faces with thin ink lines for eyes and mouth and a pale white face, heavy robes in dull deep green, indigo, black and off-white with tiny patterned hems, firm black ink outlines of slightly uneven weight, stylised white cloud scrolls, simple flat flowers. Flat colour, no shading, no perspective, a naive but masterful folk-ritual hand. Use ONLY the style of the reference: do not copy its gods, horsemen, rows of figures, rosettes or cartouches. Calm and dignified. It must look like a museum photograph of a real, old, hand-painted original, the kind hung on a gallery wall, indistinguishable from the reference: the same hand, the same brush, the same pigments, the same age. The image is only the painted surface, filling the frame edge to edge: no wall, no frame, no label. NOT digital illustration, NOT a game or cartoon or anime or children's-book style, no big eyes, no cute or chibi faces, no glossy or airbrushed rendering, no 3D, no soft gradients, no bokeh. Absolutely no text, letters, Chinese characters, seals, stamps or watermarks.

families.Flower-Souls: Background: the flat vermilion-red ground of the reference, with stylised flowers on thin stems, gold and silver blossoms, and white cloud scrolls.

heroFamilies.Flower-Souls: Background: the flat vermilion-red ground of the reference, with stylised flowers on thin stems, gold and silver blossoms, and white cloud scrolls.

subjects.MB1-H01-kitten: A flower-soul: a tiny child whose small stylised face appears in the heart of a big flat flower, the petals forming its robe, drawn like the small figures of the reference; the littlest flower-soul: a small girl's face in a still-closed silver bud on a tall curling stem, alone in the middle of the sky garden, looking straight out.
subjects.MB1-H01-bigcat: A flower-soul: a tiny child whose small stylised face appears in the heart of a big flat flower, the petals forming its robe, drawn like the small figures of the reference; the littlest flower-soul in full bloom: the silver flower opened wide around the small girl like a round mandorla of petals, silver and gold petals falling around her in the red sky garden, frontal and symmetrical like a small deity.
subjects.MB1-D01: Mẻ Bjoóc, Mother Flower, who keeps the garden of children's souls in the sky: an old woman enthroned frontally in the middle, pale face with calm ink features, dark indigo headscarf, long indigo and deep green robes, holding a round tray of gold and silver flowers on her lap; around her, in the manner of the reference's tiers, rows of small flowers on stems each with a tiny child's face.
subjects.MB1-D02: A flower-soul: a tiny child whose small stylised face appears in the heart of a big flat flower, the petals forming its robe, drawn like the small figures of the reference; a golden flower-soul: a small boy's face in a wide-open golden flower on a tall stem, arms of leaves raised, a few golden petals drifting.
subjects.MB1-D03: a Then singer tending a flower in the sky garden: a woman in a long indigo robe and a small dark headdress, kneeling in profile beside one drooping silver flower that holds a small child's face, pouring water from a gourd onto its roots, a long-necked gourd lute on her back.
